title: CUQAReport
description: The code quality report produced by the CUQA agent (Agent 1) and normalized by the Orchestration Agent (backend/domain/cuqa_normalizer.py::normalize_cuqa_report). This is the FIRST contract in the chain: CUQA -> Orchestration -> DIWO Code Smell Review. It is served by GET/POST /api/cuqa/quality-report and embedded in the POST /api/workflows/from-cuqa response. Derived from a live report of the C_Backend_CodeSmells_Project workspace, so every field below is one the system actually emits.

files.description: Every analysed file, including files with no code smells. Files are never dropped here — the developer has to be able to see what was clean.

repo_name.description: Repository name for a repository report; the relative path for a single-file report.

source.description: Stamped by the normalizer so a report's origin is never ambiguous downstream.

report_type.description: Whether CUQA analysed the whole workspace or one file. A file report is wrapped into the same repository shape so callers handle one structure.

severity.description: Normalized severity. Anything CUQA emits outside this set is coerced to 'low' rather than dropped.

codeSmell.description: One detected smell. CUQA reports `line` for every smell and adds start_line/end_line plus per-smell metrics for the types that have them, so this object is intentionally open.

type.description: PascalCase smell type, e.g. LongMethod, MagicNumber, UnsafeFunctionUsage. Never empty — an unnamed smell is normalized to 'Unknown'.

line.description: 1-based line. Null for a smell CUQA attributes to the file rather than a line; the smell id then uses 0 in that position.

entity.description: The class, function or file the smell is attached to. Which one it means depends on the smell type — see CLASS_LEVEL_SMELLS / METHOD_LEVEL_SMELLS in backend/domain/cuqa_normalizer.py.

relative_path.description: Repository-relative path with forward slashes. This is the key everything downstream joins on — smell ids, plan targets and archive entries are all built from it.

metrics.description: Whatever CUQA measured for this file. The set varies by language — a C file carries include_count and global_variables, a Java file carries classes — so extra keys are expected.

quality_score.description: 0-100. Defaults to 100 when CUQA reports none.

error.description: Present only when this file could not be parsed.
